problems: Doesn't read as a lasso. The coil and the noose sit side by side on a diagonal at about the same size, linked by a thin S-bend, so it looks like two rings or handcuffs. The big open loop should be clearly larger than the hank and hang from it.
The noose is a separate closed ring hooked on the honda, not the same rope. The rope from the coil should run through the honda eye, go around as the loop and end at the eye.
The honda's 0.025 opening is narrower than the 0.03 rope that has to pass through it, so the eye can't work.
The free end with its cream whipping is hidden behind the hank. Only a loose white stub shows near the middle, and another cream sleeve on the honda reads as a second stray stub.
Framing: the long diagonal leaves the top-right and bottom-left empty, so the object doesn't fill the card as one compact shape.

The hank is seen almost straight down its axis. The coils stack along y, the camera looks along y, and the coils are packed tight (pitch = 2r), so the three-plus turns merge into one thick ring. The card reads as a figure-8 of two rings, not a coiled rope with a loop.
The coils are perfect copies of each other with nothing offsetting them, so nothing separates one coil from the next. Real hanks are a little sheared and uneven.

Fix: spread the stack in depth (0.2 to 0.34), shear the coil centers a little per turn, and turn the hero further about z (12 to 30 degrees) so the side of the stack shows. The tie band and the honda move with the new stack depth.
